article.title: Hindi to English: Shopping context
article.description: Hindi: 'क्या आपके पास इसका बड़ा साइज़ है?' English: 'Do you have this in a bigger size?' Teaching point: natural English phrasing avoids literally translating 'बड़ा साइज़' as 'big size' — native speakers say 'a bigger size' or 'a larger size'.
